title: Working car in Animal Crossing PC PORT
author: Octominou
selftext: Need a lot of works, but it's crazy to think you can do this kind of stuff in 10min with a solo prompt.

comments.author: throwawaybrisbent
comments.body:
that is crazy, it also seem kinda useless given how much shit you're crashing into. Maybe a scooter, bike or moped is a better option. 

Did it design the car or as the asset already in the game?

replies.author: Octominou
replies.body:
Yeah, it was honestly a shitty prompt like 'Put a car in Animal Crossing, use a car model that already exists in the game (Gracie's car) and make it go 200% player speed'.

Right now it's a useless (too many obstacles), though it's pretty wild that a single prompt gets you something kinda working... I'll try the scooter next haha.

replies.author: RemarkableWish2508
replies.body:
If you know how games work, how 99% of them is pure illusion, then you realize that AI didn't do particularly much.

A person with access to the source code and some basic knowledge of how it's organized, could do something similar in anywhere from 10 minutes to... however many features does it have.
